variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: An NLP system architecture is the complete path that turns language into a dependable product decision. It accepts text, applies the exact preprocessing expected by a model, schedules inference, interprets the output, and records enough evidence to operate and improve the system.
variants.prompt: Match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Classify or extract
pairs.detail: Moderation, intent, language, and entity systems map text to a small result.
pairs.explanation: Moderation, intent, language, and entity systems map text to a small result. They often use encoder models and can batch inputs with similar lengths.

pairs.label: Retrieve or rank
pairs.detail: Search and recommendation systems encode queries or documents, then depend on an index whose embedding model, tokenizer, and corpus version must remain compatible.
pairs.explanation: Search and recommendation systems encode queries or documents, then depend on an index whose embedding model, tokenizer, and corpus version must remain compatible.

pairs.label: Generate text
pairs.detail: Summarization and conversational systems pay for input prefill and token-by-token output.
pairs.explanation: Summarization and conversational systems pay for input prefill and token-by-token output. Context limits, streaming, safety policy, and cancellation become first-class controls.

variants.hint:

Retrieve or rank: Search and recommendation systems encode queries or documents, then depend on an index whose embedding model, tokenizer, and corpus version must remain compatible.

pairs.label: Synchronous serving
pairs.detail: Use it when the decision is needed immediately.
pairs.explanation: Use it when the decision is needed immediately. Keep the path short, enforce a deadline at admission, bound every queue, and define a fallback or explicit rejection.

pairs.label: Asynchronous processing
pairs.detail: Use it for large documents, backfills, enrichment, and offline embeddings.
pairs.explanation: Use it for large documents, backfills, enrichment, and offline embeddings. Persist job identity, input and model versions, retry state, progress, and idempotent result writes.
